subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Striking one of Bongo Bongo's hands turns it blue and causes it to drop an arrow or a magic bottle.

evidence.quote: When you hit one hand it will turn blue and drop an item, either an arrow or a magic bottle, both of which you will be needing for this battle.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Equipping the Lens of Truth allows Link to see Bongo Bongo, shoot his eye with the Fairy Bow, and defeat him in two knockdowns using the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote: Once both hands are hit then position yourself in the middle of the map, between them and facing them, and equip the Lens of Truth.  Only using this will you actually be able to see the boss.  Take aim with your Fairy Bow and fire at his eye.  When you do this the boss drops and you are free to go in with the Biggoron's Sword swinging like crazy.  The thing about this boss is that using the Biggoron's Sword, you only have to do this twice, the boss will die on the second set of sword swings, so this is why I say offensive is so good.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: Iron Knuckle attacks deal up to 4 hearts of damage, and dodging the attacks to perform jump attacks takes at least seven or eight hits to defeat him.

evidence.quote: His attacks can deal up to four hearts worth of damage.  He has two types of attacks, a double horizontal slash and a powerful over head slash.  The basic tactic for both of them is the same, avoid it and use the jump attack.
this guy, even using the jump attack it's at least seven or eight.

subject: Twinrova
text: In the first phase of Twinrova, deflecting an ice or fire beam with the Mirror Shield at the opposite sister advances the fight after two or three hits.

evidence.quote: In order to defeat the bosses what you have to do is deflect the beam of one boss and aim it at another boss.  The beam is constant so you'll be able to swing it around for a couple seconds in hope of hitting the other boss...Each of them must take two or three hits before the second phase begins.

subject: Twinrova
text: In Twinrova's second phase, absorbing three matching fire or ice attacks with the Mirror Shield blasts her out of the sky, requiring two knockouts with the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote: You need to absorb three of the same elements in a row and then that will fire off a blast at the boss and knock her down...With the Biggoron's Sword you should only have to knock her out two times before she dies.

subject: Twinrova
text: Defeating Twinrova awards a Heart Container.

evidence.quote: Defeating the boss nets you a HEART CONTAINER after the scene, then as usual

subject: Twinrova
text: Defeating Twinrova leads to seeing the sages and receiving the Spirit Medallion.

evidence.quote: you will be brought to see the sages and be given the SPIRIT MEDALLION.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Deflecting Ganondorf's energy blasts with the Biggoron's Sword, shooting him with a Light Arrow, and attacking with Jump Attacks defeats him in 3 knockdowns.

evidence.quote: Ganondorf will fire an energy blast at you, deflect it with your sword and he'll deflect it back.  Keep doing this over and over again until eventually it hits him.  At this point you have a very short window of time to bring up a Light Arrow and fire it at him...Doing this it will only take a mere three
knock downs to actually take him out, but the battle isn't over yet.

subject: Ganon
text: During the first phase against Ganon without the Master Sword, Link can roll under his legs and strike his tail with the Biggoron's Sword or Megaton Hammer, or stun his face with a Light Arrow.

evidence.quote: The first thing of course that you will notice when this battle begins is that you do not have your Master Sword for the fight, there are two weapons of choice here, obviously the Biggoron's Sword takes top place but given that you won't necessarily have it, the Megaton Hammer comes second...The tactic to use here is relatively simple, with whatever weapon you are using, roll under Ganon's legs and slash like crazy at his tail...The alternative to this is targeting his face with the L/Z button and firing a Light Arrow to stun him, then simply running around behind and doing the same thing.

subject: Ganon
text: Zelda returns the Master Sword at the battle's halfway point, and only a swing of the Master Sword can strike the final blow to defeat Ganon.

evidence.quote: At about the half way point Ganon will fall and Zelda will allow you to grab the Master Sword again...The battle can only be won with a swing of the
Master Sword, no other weapon will suffice.  Strike the final blow and...
